create_harmonic_embedding_module: create a HarmonicEmbedding module with custom n_harmonic_functions and omega_0 for NeRF positional encoding
run_harmonic_embedding_forward: run forward pass on a tensor through HarmonicEmbedding to get sin and cos features
run_harmonic_embedding_with_covariance: run HarmonicEmbedding forward with diag_cov to approximate conical frustums as Gaussians for MIP-NeRF
get_harmonic_embedding_output_dim: get the output dimension of a HarmonicEmbedding instance for a given input dimension size
get_harmonic_embedding_output_dim_static: get the static output dimension for HarmonicEmbedding without instantiating the module
